#!/usr/bin/python3
import os
import uuid
try:
    import BaseHTTPServer as http
except ImportError:
    import http.server as http

BASE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
RECEIVED = os.path.join(BASE, "received")
STAGING = os.path.join(BASE, ".staging")
MAX_BODY = 65536
READ_CHUNK = 8192

os.makedirs(RECEIVED, exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs(STAGING, exist_ok=True)

class Handler(http.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"

    def _reply(self, status, body=b""):
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.send_header("Connection", "close")
        self.end_headers()
        if self.command != "HEAD" and body:
            self.wfile.write(body)
        self.close_connection = True

    def _not_found(self):
        self._reply(404, b"Not Found\n")

    def handle_expect_100(self):
        if self.path != "/upload":
            self._not_found()
            return False
        try:
            length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", ""))
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            self._reply(400, b"Invalid Content-Length\n")
            return False
        if length > MAX_BODY:
            self._reply(413, b"Payload Too Large\n")
            return False
        if length < 0:
            self._reply(400, b"Invalid Content-Length\n")
            return False
        self.send_response_only(100)
        self.end_headers()
        return True

    def do_POST(self):
        if self.path != "/upload":
            self._not_found()
            return
        if self.headers.get("Transfer-Encoding"):
            self._reply(400, b"Content-Length required\n")
            return
        raw_length = self.headers.get("Content-Length")
        if raw_length is None:
            self._reply(411, b"Content-Length required\n")
            return
        try:
            length = int(raw_length)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            self._reply(400, b"Invalid Content-Length\n")
            return
        if length < 0:
            self._reply(400, b"Invalid Content-Length\n")
            return
        if length > MAX_BODY:
            self._reply(413, b"Payload Too Large\n")
            return

        token = [REDACTED]]]
        temporary = os.path.join(STAGING, token + ".tmp")
        final = os.path.join(RECEIVED, token + ".bin")
        complete = False
        try:
            remaining = length
            with open(temporary, "xb") as output:
                while remaining:
                    chunk = self.rfile.read(min(READ_CHUNK, remaining))
                    if not chunk:
                        break
                    output.write(chunk)
                    remaining -= len(chunk)
                if remaining == 0:
                    output.flush()
                    os.fsync(output.fileno())
                    complete = True
            if not complete:
                try:
                    os.unlink(temporary)
                except FileNotFoundError:
                    pass
                self._reply(400, b"Incomplete request body\n")
                return
            os.replace(temporary, final)
            directory_fd = os.open(RECEIVED, os.O_RDONLY)
            try:
                os.fsync(directory_fd)
            finally:
                os.close(directory_fd)
            self._reply(200, b"Upload accepted\n")
        except (BrokenPipeError, ConnectionResetError):
            try:
                os.unlink(temporary)
            except FileNotFoundError:
                pass
        except Exception:
            try:
                os.unlink(temporary)
            except FileNotFoundError:
                pass
            raise

    do_GET = _not_found
    do_HEAD = _not_found
    do_PUT = _not_found
    do_DELETE = _not_found
    do_PATCH = _not_found
    do_OPTIONS = _not_found

class Server(http.HTTPServer):
    allow_reuse_address = True

Server(("", 8080), Handler).serve_forever()
